g.title: b0_four_experiments
g.text: Part B's four experiments, and where each fits inside Drive-JEPA
grey: the release, frozen · blue: the side-car and its agents · green: trains an adapter + LoRA · amber: a rule, trains nothing

g.title: refiner
g.text: each pass decodes 32 proposals × 8 poses (4 s),
and deformable attention to the map

g.title: scorer
g.text: an MLP: a final score each

g.title: b3
g.text: B-3 · the agents into the refiner
changes: the 32 proposals, from every pass on
trains: an adapter + LoRA on the refiner
tests: do the proposals themselves get better?
read: the best of the 32, with agents (F) against without (C)

g.title: pick
g.text: the highest score: one 4 s plan

g.title: b2
g.text: B-2 · the agents into the scorer
changes: which of the release's own 32 is picked
trains: an adapter + LoRA on the scorer
tests: does a scorer that reads the agents pick better?
read: the pick's EPDMS, F against C, and against B-1

g.title: b1
g.text: changes: removes proposals that come too close to an agent
trains: nothing; a rule on clearances
tests: do the agents know of collisions the scorer misses?
read: the pick's EPDMS against the release

g.title: b0
g.text: : settings chosen on the R-clean split; navtest read once, by NAVSIM's official scorer,
after the release's 87.78 is reproduced there; every trained arm starts as the release, exactly

g.title: b4
g.text: changes: proposals and pick together; B-3's refiner,
then B-2's scorer retrained on its proposals
tests: does it meet or beat 87.78, because of the agents?
read: EPDMS, F against C and against the release;
